profile.headline: Husband, Father, Software Engineer
profile.summary:
- 28 years of Software Engineering/Leadership Experience. Experience in all phases of Software Engineering, including concept/prototype, requirements, design, development, test, implementation, and support.
- 20 years of Java programming on LINUX/UNIX, macOS, and Windows platforms
- 5+ years experience integrating and coordinating development efforts with offshore teams, including teams in Costa Rica, Italy, and India
- 5+ years of experience with Agile/Scrum methodology
- 7 years of cumulative management experience. 3 years leading teams of up to 8 software engineers and 4+ years managing 5 employees in my own business
- 4 years of international experience working in Spain and Germany on client site for two years each, respectively
- Sun Certified Programmer For The Java 2 Platform
- 4 years of C++ programming on Windows and LINUX/UNIX platforms
- 3 years of COBOL programming on IBM 3090 and VAX platforms
- Perfect fluency in Spanish.
- Some knowledge of German, Italian, and Portuguese

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leader for 11+ years on the software engineering team for Maxar's GeoSpatial Cloud Services (GCS) application suite, which is an application suite that provides high resolution satellite imagery to users via several different means.  The GCS application consists of 20+ Java services using Spring Framework running in Tomcat containers in Amazon AWS.

During my tenure on the GCS team, I have been involved in the design, implementation, and/or technical oversight of practically every major feature that was added to the system.

Regularly participated in the interview and selection process of new engineering personnel.

For about the past 4 years, coordinated the work of 4 offshore (Costa Rica) development teams.  Although not officially an engineering management role, it was practically everything but the personnel aspect of a management role.  In this role, as one of the resident SMEs of the GCS platform, I was deeply involved in coordinating the feature design, development, and testing efforts of these 4 teams and I also made sure that the teams' efforts were well coordinated together so as to work most efficiently.  This role has included leadership and review of feature designs, leadership and review of the development efforts, and consultation for the testing efforts.  At the same time, I maintained my leadership role as a Principal Software Engineer on the local development efforts in Colorado.

The DGCS application stack consists of Spring POJOs running on Tomcat containers talking to other internal web services using Spring Remoting and to a Postgres PostGIS database using Hibernate and Spring JDBC.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of the software engineering team for Local Matters' Destination Search web application.

Developed, maintained, and enhanced the Destination Search product offerings in accordance with requirements sold to the clients and to address major issues with the software.

Destination search is a web application with a JSP and JavaScript UI and a Java middle­-tier. It utilizes Spring MVC and Spring IOC as well as some Hibernate.

positions.title: Manager of Software Engineering
positions.description:
Managed a team of 6 software engineers ­­ 5 local engineers in Longmont, CO and 1 remote engineer in Lisle, IL. The team supports several web based and other user interfacing applications such as 9­1­1 IM, 9­1­1 Net, ECRC Query, PCC, and InfoCheck. 

Participated in the definition and review of business requirements. 

The 9­1­1 IM application was a Java web application used to maintain telco 9­1­1 data. During tenure as manager, led the team to significantly reduce the number of outstanding defects on 9­1­1 IM and to the timely release of the 7.0, 8.0, 9.0, and 10.0 versions of 9­1­1 IM application. 

The 9­1­1 NET application was an application similar to 9­1­1 IM but with a different target audience. This project involved local resources in Longmont, CO and also the remote resources of an offshore outsourcing partner. Led the team to the successful completion of the 6.0 release and most of the 7.0 release. 

Maintained technical skills by participating in development on several projects as needed.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of the software engineering team for Intrado’s 9­1­1 IM web application. 

Developed, deployed, maintained, and enhanced the 9­1­1 IM product offering in accordance with requirements sold to the clients and to address major issues with the software. The 9­1­1 IM application was originally a J2EE/EJB application. It was eventually converted from EJBs to Spring Framework POJOs and I participated in that conversion. 

Member of the software engineering team for Intrado’s IntelliCast® Notification Services (INS) product offering: 

Developed, deployed, maintained, and enhanced the NDService component of INS, a socket server written almost entirely in Java, that is capable of interfacing with myriad different calling platforms through a pseudo HTTP/XML message set that was developed. 

Developed, deployed, maintained, and enhanced the Calling Platform Database (CPDatabase) component of INS, a SQL Server 2000 database at the heart of the INS reverse­ 911­ type notification infrastructure. The CPDatabase consisted of two fully replicated databases residing on two different database servers, using updatable subscriptions to transactional and merge publications to keep themselves synchronized. Database functionality was concentrated in Transact­SQL stored procedures. 

Responsible for general maintenance of various INS components including the ASP Web Application, the ArcSDE database, and several front­end and back­end processes written in C++, Java, and Visual Basic.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Verified and resolved bugs in the J1 EBPP application, the Java version of Solant’s pioneer WebObjects EBPP platform. The J1 application was J2EE compliant and was implemented with EJB, XML, XSL, WebLogic, TopLink, and JMS technologies. Also tested releases of the J1 application by maintaining and executing automated test scripts using WinRunner and TestDirector. 

Participated in requirements gathering, detailed design, and coding activities for the Depository component of Trinity, Avolent’s next generation Electronic Bill Presentment & Payment (EBPP) system. These activities included extensive research and prototyping to evaluate WebDAV and Castor products for use in the Depository. For situations Castor, an open source data binding framework for Java, couldn’t handle, such as writing large BLOB and CLOB objects to the Oracle database, straight JDBC was used. 

Performed release manager activities whereby releases of the sub­components of Trinity were coordinated across the Westminster, CO and San Francisco, CA development sites. This included coordinating code freezes, building and regression testing the software, and compiling release notes.
